_note: A case type's field has a name a rule and the API use (bouwkosten) and a title a person reads (Bouwkosten, Building costs), and a choice list can give each option a short code (Woning WON). DqZaaktypeVelden lists the fields by title and draws the choice list's codes. The Fields tab falls back to the name where a field has no title. A fragment rather than an edit to dossiq_register.json, per ADR-037.

title.title: Title
title.description: What a person reads for the field, in their language. Without one the field's name is shown.

enumCodes.title: Option codes
enumCodes.description: A short code per choice list option, by the option's value (Woning: WON). An option without one shows none.
